title: Mission 1: The Practice Frontier
desc: Execute your first simulator buy order in the Watchlist Desk.

title: Mission 2: Theory Pioneer
desc: Pass at least 3 knowledge checks anywhere in the Academy.

title: Mission 3: Discipline Shield
desc: Complete the Realistic Investor Profiler on the Profile screen.

title: Mission 4: Course Crusher
desc: Complete every chapter of the Stock Market Basics course.

title: Mission 5: Beyond Beginner
desc: Unlock a course past the BEGINNER tier in the Academy.

title: Mission 6: Derivatives Debut
desc: Complete the Futures & Options course in the Academy.

title: Mission 7: Certified Risk Manager
desc: Complete every chapter of all 6 Academy courses and earn your graduation certificate.
